title: Gale's Top Trading Cycles (Shapley-Scarf Housing Market)
authors: Ruy Jose Guerra Barretto de Queiroz
summary: A Lean formalization of Gale's top trading cycles algorithm (1974) for the Shapley-Scarf housing market. Finitely many agents (Fin n) each own exactly one house (the endowment is a bijection endow : Fin n ≃ Fin n) and have strict preferences over houses, given most-preferred-first as per-agent permutations rank i : Fin n ≃ Fin n; agent i strictly prefers house a over house b iff (rank i).symm a < (rank i).symm b.
